description: This file contains utility functions related to handling request data and selecting models within the LiteLLM project. It includes functions to ensure request payload safety, pick the cheapest chat models from a provider, and retrieve proxy server request headers.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _ensure_extra_body_is_safe(extra_body: Optional[Dict])
methods.description: Ensures the extra request body is safe for JSON serialization, particularly handling objects like TextPromptClient.

methods.name: pick_cheapest_chat_models_from_llm_provider(custom_llm_provider: str, n=1)
methods.description: Selects the n cheapest chat models from a specified LLM provider.

methods.name: dict get_proxy_server_request_headers(litellm_params: Optional[dict])
methods.description: Retrieves request headers for the LiteLLM proxy server from provided parameters.
